seo.title: Event Production & Technical Solutions Across Japan
seo.description: TOTAL MEDIA plans, produces, and delivers corporate events, conferences, exhibitions, and hybrid broadcasts across Japan — LED, audio, lighting, staging, and streaming, end to end.
seo.orgDescription: Full-service event production and technical solutions company operating across Japan — event planning, technical production, and equipment rental.

hero.title: Creating Exceptional Events Across Japan.
hero.description: We plan, produce, and engineer corporate events, conferences, exhibitions, and hybrid broadcasts — LED, audio, lighting, staging, and streaming, delivered as one accountable production from a single technical partner.

companyIntro.title: Equipment rental is one part of what we do. It was never the whole business.
companyIntro.paragraph1: TOTAL MEDIA is a complete event production and technical solutions company operating nationwide across Japan. We plan events, design technical production, manage exhibitions and conferences on-site, and operate the LED, audio, lighting, and camera systems ourselves — as one accountable team, not a coordination exercise across separate vendors.
companyIntro.paragraph2: International companies, Japanese corporations, event agencies, government bodies, universities, and luxury brands come to us when the technical execution has to be right the first time, with no second take.

coreServices.title: Core Services
coreServices.description: From full event production to individual technical disciplines — engaged together or on their own.

industriesServed.title: Industries We Work With
industriesServed.description: Different sectors bring different constraints — procurement cycles, protocol, brand standards. We scope to the client, not a template.

whyChooseUs.title: What Sets Us Apart
whyChooseUs.description: These aren't marketing lines — they're the operational commitments every proposal is built on.

reasons.title: One Accountable Team
reasons.description: Planning, technical design, and on-site execution from a single team — not a coordination exercise across separate vendors.

reasons.title: Nationwide Coverage
reasons.description: Equipment and crew logistics built for events across Japan, from major convention centers to regional venues.

reasons.title: In-House Equipment
reasons.description: LED, audio, lighting, and rigging maintained and calibrated on our own schedule — not subcontracted piecemeal.

reasons.title: Bilingual by Default
reasons.description: Japanese/English project management and on-site coordination as standard for international stakeholders.

reasons.title: Redundant Technical Systems
reasons.description: Dual circuits and backup paths for anything broadcast-critical, monitored by a dedicated technical director.

reasons.title: Transparent Pricing
reasons.description: Every proposal itemizes equipment, labor, and production management separately — no bundled black-box pricing.

processSteps.title: Our Process
processSteps.description: The same five stages whether the event is a boardroom briefing or a two-day conference.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.description: We start with your objectives, audience, and constraints — not a standard package.

steps.title: Proposal & Design
steps.description: A detailed technical plan and transparent, itemized pricing within 1–2 business days.

steps.title: Pre-Production
steps.description: Venue coordination, equipment allocation, and technical rehearsal before event day.

steps.title: Live Execution
steps.description: On-site production management and technical operation by the team that designed it.

steps.title: Post-Event Review
steps.description: A structured report and asset handover — what worked, and what to refine next time.

equipmentShowcase.title: A Nationwide Technical Inventory
equipmentShowcase.description: Broadcast and touring-grade equipment, maintained on a fixed inspection schedule — available on its own or with our production team.

latestArticles.title: Latest Articles
latestArticles.description: Field notes on event planning, technical production, and what we've learned running events across Japan.

homeFaq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
homeFaq.description: A few of the questions we hear most often from new clients.

cta.title: Ready to Plan Your Next Event?
cta.description: Tell us what you're planning and we'll respond with a detailed proposal within 1–2 business days.
